title: Observation: one find or one result, exactly as it came (one line of log/observations/*.jsonl)
description: Append-only. Never edited, never deleted. Entities are rebuilt from observations and events. kind 'find': a census record from a search or a census file; 'refine': a higher-level description of a quantity of an existing entity; 'import': data imported from a repository file (exact data, interval enclosures, joins).

seq.description: Position in the log of this (container, d, N); replay order.

raw.description: The record as found, every field kept (for a census record: the fields of kisscrit.search.record plus hits, src, prov, surg).

target.description: For kind refine: the entity the result describes.

file_name.description: Repository-relative path, or a bare file name for run output; never a host or home path.

prov.description: The search provenance written by scripts/explore/explore_worker.py (absent for census files).
